intro.title: AIRKEY
intro.line: Your keyboard is the AI. NEAR is the leash.

beats.title: A scam lands in your DMs.
Pay by typing
beats.sub: “pay harshal 0.2”, hold, paid. The receipt goes into the chat.

beats.title: The AI is fooled. The leash isn't.
beats.sub: Blocked on chain by the leash contract (R4).

beats.title: A call becomes a trade
beats.sub: Checked against NEAR Intents, inside the Trading Agent's caps.

beats.title: Someone new? Approve.
beats.sub: It waits on chain until Face ID says yes.

beats.title: One kill switch
beats.sub: Every agent stops. The contract enforces it.
